<entry id="H00931">
<head-word>חָכִיר, </head-word>
<head-word>חָכוּר</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (חָכַר) </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>tenant</italic> on a fixed rent payable in kind, v. 
<xref rid="A03108">אָרִיס II</xref>. Y. Bicc. I, end, 64
<sup>b</sup> ח' לשעה a tenant for a fixed term, ח' לעולם a permanent tenant (on ground rent).</definition>
<notes> B. Mets. 104
<sup>a</sup> חוֹכֵר; a. fr.—
<plural-form>Pl. חֲכִירִין, חֲכוּ', חֲכִירוֹת,</plural-form> (חוֹכְרִין) חֲכוּרוֹת. Y. Bicc. l. c. חֲכוּרֵי בתי אבות hereditary tenants. Tosef. Peah III, 1. Ib. Ter. II, 11 חוכרין ed. Zuck. (Var. חכורות, חכירות). Y. M. Kat. III, 82
<sup>b</sup> bot. חֲכִירָיו.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>the fixed annual rent in kind</italic>.</definition>
<notes> B. Mets. IX, 2 (103
<sup>b</sup>) מנכה לו מן חֲכִירוֹ Talm. ed. (Mish. חֲכוּ') he deducts from the stipulated rent (in proportion). Ib. 4 (105
<sup>a</sup>) הואיל ואני נותן לך חֲכִירְךָ (Y. ed. חֲכוּרְךָ, Mish. חֲכוּרָהּ) as long as I give thee thy rent (Mish.: the rent for it).</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="H00934">
<head-word>(חֲכוּרוּת) חֲכִירוּת</head-word>
<pos> f.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (v. 
<xref rid="H00930">חָכִיר</xref>) </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>tenancy, tenure</italic> on rent in kind.</definition>
<notes> Bicc. I, 11 בעלי אריסות וח' 
<italic>landlords</italic> of properties held in tenure, on shares, or on fixed rent; or 
<italic>tenants</italic> on &c.; expl. Y. ib. 64
<sup>b</sup> either חכירי בתי אבות (v. חָכִיר), or בעלי אריסיות וחֲכִירִיּוֹת (not וחכורות).</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>stipulated rent</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Tosef. B. Mets. IX, 24 ח' של שתי שנים Var. (ed. Zuck. only חכורי) the rent for two years in advance.—
<plural-form>Pl. חֲכִירִיּוֹת,</plural-form> v. supra.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="H00935">
<head-word>חָכַךְ, </head-word>
<hw-number>I</hw-number>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (v. Fl. to Levy Talm. Dict. II, 204
<sup>2</sup>) </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to restrain, fasten, hook</italic>.</definition>
<notes>—Denom. חַכָּה.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to grasp</italic> (one another), 
<italic>to wrestle</italic>; v. 
<xref rid="H00014">חָבַב II</xref>.</definition>
<notes /></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="H00936">
<head-word>חָכַךְ, </head-word>
<hw-number>II</hw-number>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (onomatop.) </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be rough; to rub, scratch</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Naz. 59
<sup>a</sup> מהו לָחוֹךְ how about (removing the hair by) rubbing (Tosaf.: לחוך ולהִתְחַכֵּךְ about rubbing or being rubbed)?</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition> (cmp. חָרַט, a. חַיָּיךְ) 
<italic>to hesitate</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ned. I, 1 היה חוֹכֵךְ בזה להחמיר had some hesitation about deciding in favor of greater stringency (for the expression מנודה; oth. opin. in R. N. to Bab. ib. 7
<sup>a</sup>: denom. of חֵךְ, 
<italic>had a taste for</italic> &c.).</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִתְחַכִּךְ, </binyan-form>
<binyan-name>Nithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נִתְחַכֵּךְ</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to rub one’s self against a rough object; to be rubbed</italic>.</definition>
<notes> B. Kam. IV, 6 שור שהיה מִתְחַכֵּךְ וכ' an ox that scratched himself against a wall; Tosef. ib. IV, 6. B. Kam. 3
<sup>a</sup> נִתְחַכְּכָה וכ' she (the animal) scratched herself against a wall for her gratification (without intention to do injury) &c.—Naz. 59
<sup>a</sup>, v. supra; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pi.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>חִיכֵּךְ</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (v. 
<xref rid="H00314">חוּךְ II</xref>) 
<italic>to hawk; to deride</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Gen. R. s. 67 (play on הכי, Gen. XXVII, 36) התחיל מְחַכֵּךְ בגרונו וכ' he began to hawk with his throat (to express contempt), like one that hawks and spits; Tanḥ. Ki Thetsé 10; Pesik. Zakh., p. 27
<sup>b</sup>, v. זְמוֹרָה; [Ar. ed. Koh. s. v. זמר: חִיכְחֵךְ, 
<italic>Pilp</italic>.]—Cmp. כָּחַח.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="H00937">
<head-word>חֲכַךְ</head-word>
<language-key> ch.,</language-key>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>Ithpa.</italic> אִתְחַכֵּךְ as preced. 
<italic>Hithpa.</italic> B. Kam. 44
<sup>a</sup>.</definition>
<notes /></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="H00938">
<head-word>חֲכָךְ</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (preced.) </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>scab, sore;</italic> trnsf. 
<italic>tribulation, visitation</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. M. Kat. III, 81
<sup>d</sup> top; (B. Mets. 59
<sup>b</sup> אַךְ, Var. אַף).—
<plural-form>Pl. חֲכָכִים</plural-form>
<italic>inflammations</italic>. Gen. R. s. 19, beg. (v., however, אַבְאָבִית).</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>cough, catarrh</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Snh. X, 29
<sup>b</sup> bot. בתחלה הוא … ח' first He causes a cold to enter them; (Tanḥ., ed. Bub., R’eh 10 חִיכּוּךְ); Pesik. Asser 97
<sup>b</sup> הקב"ה ח' (insert מכניס בהם); v. וָהּ.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="H00939">
<head-word>חָכַם</head-word>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> v. 
<xref rid="H00939">חָכָם</xref>) </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be wise, to know</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Nidd. 70
<sup>b</sup> מה יעשה אדם ויֶחְכַּם what must one do in order to be wise?</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition> (denom. of חָכָם) 
<italic>to meet for deliberation</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ib. לכשיחיו נֶחְכַּם להן when they resurrect, we shall meet to discuss their case.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הֶחְכִּים</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to grow wise, to become a scholar</italic>.</definition>
<notes> B. Bath. 25
<sup>b</sup> הרוצה שיַחְכִּים he who desires to become a scholar; ib. 175
<sup>b</sup> (Ber. 63
<sup>b</sup> שיִתְחַכֵּם). Ab. II, 5 … לא כל … מַחְכִּים not every one that has a large trade, becomes wise (experienced); a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to make wise, to stimulate a person’s mind by ingenious suggestions, questions</italic> &c. Hag. 14
<sup>a</sup> תלמיד המַחְכִּים וכ' a student who enlightens his teachers.</definition>
<notes> B. Mets. 107
<sup>b</sup> ומַחְכִּימַת פתי and makes the simple wise.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to subtilize, philosophize</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ex. R. s. 6, beg. ה' על גזרתו וכ' philosophized on (tried to find out the reasons for) the Lord’s law. Ib. מה שהייתי מַחְכִּים וכ' when I philosophised … and made myself believe …, it was all vain boast &c.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִתְחַכֵּם, </binyan-form>
<binyan-name>Nithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נִתְחַכֵּם</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to become wise</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ber. 63
<sup>b</sup>, v. supra. B. Bath. 25
<sup>b</sup> מתוך שמִתְחַכֵּם מתעשר because by becoming wise, he will get rich. Pesik. R. s. 33 beg. מאליו נתח' became wise by his own speculation.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="H00940">
<head-word>חֲכַם, </head-word>
<head-word>חֲכִים</head-word>
<head-word>חַכִּים</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (adj. with verbal inflection) </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be wise, shrewd; to be learned</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. I Kings V, 11. Targ. O. Ex. XV, 8 חֲכִימוּ (חַכִּ', h. text נערמו!). Targ. Is. XXIX, 16; a. fr.—Gitt. 56
<sup>b</sup> דחַכְמִיתוּ וכ' that you are so wise. Taan. 23
<sup>b</sup> דנִיחְכִּים טובא that we may become well-learned; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to recognize, to know, remember</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Y. II Gen. XXXVII, 33 (some ed. חַכַּם 
<italic>Pa.</italic>).—Targ. II Esth. II, 18; a. fr.—Lev. R. s. 30 ח' את וכ' doest thou know anything in favor of this man?—Y. M. Kat. III, 83
<sup>b</sup> top, v. בְּאַר—Y. Ber. II, 4
<sup>d</sup> top וחַכְמִין אינון כלום do they (the dead) know anything?—Y. Shek. VII, 50
<sup>c</sup> bot. יֶחְכְּמוּן שפייא קיטריהון let the wine-dealers identify their knots (marks on the wine bottles). Y. Keth. V, 30
<sup>a</sup> bot. [read:] חֲכִים אנא לחייתא דמילדא לי (or חַכִּים) I (as an infant) 
<pgbrk id="pg463" />recognized the midwife that assisted at my birth (when she came to nurse my mother). Y. Ter. XI, end, 48
<sup>b</sup> לא אנא ח' לאבא I never knew my father. Y. Ḥag. II, 78
<sup>a</sup> top יַחְכּוּם shall select (Y. Snh. VI, 23
<sup>a</sup> bot. יטול), v. זוֹגָא.—2) (euphem. = b. h. יָדַע) 
<italic>to sleep with</italic>. Targ. Y. Gen. IV, 1 Ar. (ed. ידע). Targ. Y. II ib. XX, 16; a. e.—Y. Maas. Sh. IV, 55
<sup>b</sup> bot.; Lam. R. to I, 1 רבתי (חד כותאי </notes></sense>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to be clear, evident</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Snh. 42
<sup>a</sup>, v. זָקֵן I.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>חַכֵּים</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to make wise, teach</italic>.</definition>
<notes>. Targ. Y. Deut. XXXIV, 10. Targ. Job XXXV, 11; a. e.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to outwit</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. O. Gen. XXVII, 36 (Rashi a. l. quotes וכמני, v. כְּמַן, v. Berl. Targ. O. II, p. 10).</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Ithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>אִתְחַכֵּים</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to become wise</italic>.</definition>
<notes>. Targ. Ps. CV, 22; a. e.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be informed, aware; to learn</italic>.</definition>
<notes>. Ib. XXXV, 8. Targ. Y. Ex. II, 4.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to hold counsel</italic>.</definition>
<notes>. Targ. O. Ex. I, 10.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—4)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be recognized</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Sot. IX, 23
<sup>c</sup> bot.; Y. Yeb. XVI, 15
<sup>c</sup> מאן דבעי דלא מִתְחַכְּמָה he who desires to disguise himself; לא מִתְחַכְּמִין they were not recognized, v. נְחִירָא.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Af.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>אַחְכִּים</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to teach, make wise</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Ez. III, 2; a. e.—B. Bath. 158
<sup>b</sup> אוירא דא"י מַהְכּים the climate of Palestine makes wise.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="H00941">
<head-word>חָכָם</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> v. Fl. to Levy Talm. Dict. II, 204
<sup>2</sup>) [
<italic>retentive</italic>,] </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>one who knows</italic>.</definition>
<notes> חֲכַם הרזים He who knows the secrets (minds of men). Ber. 58
<sup>a</sup>; Tosef. ib. VII (VI), 2; Num. R. s. 21, beg.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>wise man, scholar;</italic> esp. 
<italic>Ḥ</italic>
<italic>akham</italic>, a scholar’s title, less than Rabbi.</definition>
<notes> Ab. IV, 1 איזהו ח' who is a wise man? Snh. 21
<sup>a</sup> (ref. to II Sam. XIII, </notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>3)</number>
<definition> איש ח' לרשעה a man wise for wickedness (artful).</definition>
<notes> Gitt. 67
<sup>a</sup> ח' וסופר is a scholar and a scribe; ח' לכשירצה might be a scholar, if he wanted. Hor. 13
<sup>b</sup> ר"מ ח' R. M. was the 
<italic>Ḥ</italic>
<italic>akham</italic> (counselor); a. v. fr.—
<plural-form>Pl. חֲכָמִים,</plural-form> frequ. in the sense of 
<italic>a number of scholars</italic>, as opposed to a single authority. Ḥull. 85
<sup>a</sup> ראה רבי … ושנאו בלשון ח' Rabbi approving of R. Meir’s opinion …, recorded it in the Mishnah as the opinion of ‘scholars’. Ber. I, 1; a. v. fr.—חַכְמֵי אומות העולם gentile scholars (philosophers), חכמי ישראל Jewish scholars. R. Hash. 12
<sup>a</sup>. Pes. 94
<sup>b</sup>; a. fr.—תַּלְמִיד חָכָם (= תלמיד וח', cmp. חָבֵר, abbr. ת"ח) title of a student, 
<italic>disciple, scholar</italic>. Ḥag. 15
<sup>b</sup> ת"ח אע"פ שסרח וכ' a scholar’s learning is not to be despised, even if he has gone astray. Ḥull. 9
<sup>a</sup> ת"ח צריך וכ' in order to be recognised as a 
<italic>Talmid </italic>
<italic>Ḥ</italic>
<italic>akham</italic>, one must have learned three things &c.; a. v. fr.—
<plural-form>Pl. תַּלְמִידֵי חֲכָמִים</plural-form>. Ber. 64
<sup>a</sup> ת"ה מרבים וכ' scholars increase the peace of the world; a. v. fr.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="H00944">

<pos> pr. n. m.</pos>

<sense>
<definition>
<italic>Ḥ</italic>
<italic>akhmai</italic>.</definition>
<notes> M. Kat. 9

<sup>b</sup> עַכְמַאי.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="H00945">
<head-word>חֲכָמָה</head-word>
<pos> f.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition> fem. of חָכָם.</definition>
<notes> Y. Shek. V, 48
<sup>d</sup> top הרי זו ח' that is a wise court; Snh. 17
<sup>b</sup> שלישית ח' a Sanhedrin containing three orators is a wise one.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>female physician, midwife</italic>.</definition>
<notes> R. Hash. II, 5; Erub. 45

<entry id="H01018">

<xref rid="A00083"> Pilp. of חלל)</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>

<italic>to penetrate into cavities; to perforate</italic>.</definition>

<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to shake, roll</italic> (in a vessel &c.); 
<italic>to rinse.</italic></definition>
<notes> Makhsh. III, 6 ח' לתוכן if he washed olives by rolling them in the rain water.—
<italic>Part. pass</italic>. מְחוּלְחָל, f. מְחוּלְחֶלֶת 
<italic>hollow, blown up</italic>;
<italic> loosely put in</italic>. Oh. IX, 7 כלי מח' a hollow vessel (not packed entirely), opp. אֲפוּצָה. Kel. X, 3 מגופת החבית המח' וכ' (Bart. המִתְחַלְחֶ') the stopper of a keg which can be moved around, without, however, falling out of itself. Teb. Yom I, 1; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hithpalp.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִתְחַלְחֵל, </binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>

<italic>Nithpalp</italic>.</definition>
<notes> נִתְהַלְחֵל </notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to permeate</italic>.</definition>

<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be shaken in a hollow space, to be thrown about.</italic></definition>
<notes> Mikv. IV, 3 היו צרורות מתח' וכ' if pebbles rolled about in the spout.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be permeated</italic> (with poison) 
<italic>to be affected, injured</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. B. Kam. I, beg. 2
<sup>b</sup> ונתח' כולו and the whole of it is damaged (by the heat &c.).</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—4)</number>
<definition> (cmp. חָלָה) 
<italic>to be weakened, be neutralized</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Ter. VIII, 46
<sup>a</sup> top ע"י מליחה מתח' through salting it, the poison is neutralized.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="H01022">
<head-word>חָלַט, </head-word>
<hw-number>II</hw-number>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<language-reference>
<xref rid="A00083"> cmp. חָלַץ)</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> [
<italic>to surround, tie up</italic> (corresp. to b. h. צמת),] </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to make final.</italic></definition>
<notes>
<italic> Part. pass</italic>. חָלוּט, f. חֲלוּטָה 
<italic>permanently sold, irredeemable</italic>. Arakh. IX, 4 הגיע … היה ח' וכו' (Talm. ed. 31
<sup>a</sup> היתה ח', read: חלוטה) when the last day … had passed and it (the house) was not redeemed, it was his forever …, for we read לצמיתות (Lev. XXV, 30); (Tosef. ib. V, 10 צמת). Arakh. l. c. בראשונה … שיהא ח' לו formerly the purchaser used to hide himself on the last day … in order that it might become his irredeemably; Sifra B’har ch. V, Par. 4 שתהא חלוטה לו. Arakh. 31
<sup>b</sup> למי ח' to which (of the two buyers) did it belong finally?; a. fr.—V. חֲלוּטִין.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to pass final judgment on a leper</italic> after probationary enclosure (Lev. XIII).</definition>
<notes> Zeb. 102
<sup>a</sup> אני מסגירה ואני חוֹלְטָהּ וכ' I will lock her up, declare her a leper and discharge her.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הֶחֱלִיט</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to pass final judgment, to make valid; to adjudicate</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Dem. VII, beg. 26
<sup>a</sup> צריך להַחֲלִיט וכ' he must make the consecrating conditions valid by speech. Y. Keth. X, 33
<sup>d</sup> bot. אי זה … להַחֲלִיט מַחֲלִיטִין which of them the court chooses to declare valid, it may &c. Gen. R. s. 61 שלא תַחֲלִיט להם וכ' lest thou surrender the country to them (through bad argument); Yalk. ib. 110 (insert להם). Y. Ab. Zar. I, 39
<sup>b</sup> top גסות … היא הֶחֱלִיטָתוֹ his haughtiness made Jerob. a confirmed sinner; a. e.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to declare a person a leper</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. M. Kat. I, 80
<sup>c</sup> bot. מטמא ומַחֲלִיט declares him unclean and this a decided leper; ורבנן … ומַחֲלִיטִין and the Rabbis say, he must be examined as if it were a new case, but at all events they declare &c.—
<italic>Part. pass</italic>. מוּחֲלָט, f. מוּחֲלֶטֶת 1) 
<italic>irrevocable, confirmed</italic>. Yoma 86
<sup>b</sup> תשובת המוּחֲלָטִין the repentance of the confirmed sinners.—2) 
<italic>the declared leper</italic>, opp. to מוּסְגָּר. Meg. I, 7. Yeb. 103
<sup>b</sup>. Tosef. Naz. VI, 1 מ' בספק one declared a leper from doubt; Y. ib. VIII, end, 57
<sup>b</sup>; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<italic>vay</italic>
<italic>ḥ</italic>
<italic>al</italic> (Ex. l. c.) mean? He offered &c. (ref. to Ps. XLV, 13). Ib. מהו ויחל עשה את המר וכ' he made sweet what was bitter. <italic>ḥ</italic>

<number>3)</number>

<sup>a</sup> מְחַלְּלִין עליה וכ' you may desecrate the Sabbath for the sake of curing it; a. fr.—Esp. 
<italic>to cause the loss of the priestly status</italic>. Macc. 2

<number>—2)</number>

<sup>a</sup> לעולם לא תַחֲלִיף it is not necessary to reverse (the authorities; Bets. 3

<sup>d</sup> top. Ab. Zar. 17
<sup>b</sup> מעות … נִתְחַלְּפוּ לי וכ' money set aside for Purim was mixed up with money &c. Nidd. 52
<sup>a</sup> ונִתְחַלְּפָה לך וכ' and thou madest a mistake between 
<italic>Iyob</italic> and 
<italic>oyeb;</italic> B. Bath. 16
<sup>a</sup> ונתחלף. Ib. לא נ' לי I make no mistake; a. e.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to change </italic>(
<italic>in appearance</italic>).</definition>

<sense>
<number>—3)</number>

<pgbrk id="pg472" />(displaced; Num. R. s. 9, beg. מת וכ'). Yalk. Deut. 813 כיון שנ' וכ' when the governor was recalled and another &c. Num. R. s. 5, beg. להִתְחַלֵּף מעבודה וכ' to be transferred from one service to another. Y. Taan. II, beg. 65

<entry id="H01109">
<head-word>חָלַץ</head-word>
<language-key>(b. h.,</language-key>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> v. Ges. H. Dict.
<sup>10</sup> s. v. חלץ I, II) </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to surround, fortify; to gird, arm</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Yalk. Gen. 133 (fr. Midr. Vayis‛u) חָלְצוּ עצמם they armed themselves, v. 
<italic>Pi</italic>. a. 
<italic>Hif.</italic></notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to untie, loosen, tear out; to strip, lay bare</italic>.</definition>
<notes> M. Kat. 22
<sup>b</sup> חוֹלֵץ one bares the shoulder (in mourning). Ib. IV, 7 (24
<sup>b</sup>) חוֹלְצִין. B. Mets. 59
<sup>b</sup> וח' מנעליו and took his shoes off. Y. M. Kat. III, 82
<sup>b</sup> חוֹלְצָן he takes them (the T’fillin) off; Ber. 23
<sup>a</sup>; Y. ib. II, 4
<sup>c</sup>.—Pes. 4
<sup>a</sup>; M. Kat. 20
<sup>b</sup> חֲלוֹץ לי מנעלי take my shoes off. Ḥull. 90
<sup>b</sup> חוֹלְצוֹ לתפוח he takes the sinew out and puts it on the pile &c. Tosef. Neg. VI, 10 בזמן שחוא חוֹלֵץ when he has to tear out (a leprous stone), v. נָתַץ.—Y. Ab. Zar. II, end, 42
<sup>a</sup>; Tosef. ib. IV (V), 8 כדי שיהו חוֹלְצִין את גלעיניהן in order to loosen the stones (of the olives); a. fr.—Part. pass. חָלוּץ, f. חֲלוּצָה, pl. חֲלוּצִים, f. חֲלוּצוֹת. Y. Sot. I, beg. 16
<sup>b</sup> וזרועותיה ח' her arms bared.—Sabb. 137
<sup>a</sup>, a. e. חֲלָצַתּוֹ חמה the fever left him.—Esp. 
<italic>to perform the ceremony of taking off the Yabam’s shoe</italic> (v. יָבָם); ח' ביבמה 
<italic>to arrange the </italic>
<italic>Ḥălitsah, to act as judge;</italic> ח' ל־ 
<italic>to have the shoe taken off for refusing the leviratical marriage;</italic> ח' מ־ 
<italic>to take the shoe off</italic>. Yeb. 102
<sup>a</sup> כלום ראית שח' וכ' did you ever see him act as a judge at a 
<italic>Ḥălitsah?</italic> Ib. IV, 1 החוֹלֵץ ליבמתו וכ' if one gave 
<italic>ḥălitsah</italic> to his sister-in-law, and it was found out afterwards &c. Ib. III, 1 חוֹלְצוֹת ולא מתיבמות they must be released by 
<italic>ḥăl.</italic>, but must not be married by the 
<italic>yabam</italic>. Ib. XII, 1 חָלְצָה במנעל if she performed the ceremony with a leather shoe. Ib. 102
<sup>a</sup> חוֹלְצִין במנעל you may have the ceremony performed with &c. Ib.
<sup>b</sup> שמא חָלְצָה סנדל לאחד וכ' perhaps she has performed the ceremony of 
<italic>ḥ</italic>
<italic>al</italic>. on one of the brothers. Ib. החוֹלֶצֶת מן וכ' if one performed the ceremony on an adult … Ib. (ref. to Hos. V, 6) מי כתיב ח' להם ה' מהם וכ' is it written, He had his shoe taken off by them (the Lord being the rejecting party)? It is written, He took their shoe off &c., v. next w.; a. v. fr.—חֲלוּצָה 
<italic>a woman released from leviratical marriage by ḥălitsah</italic>. Ib. VII, 1. Ib. IV, 12 חֲלוּצָתוֹ his rejected sister-in-law; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses>

<sense>

<italic>girds</italic> the poor? Answ. יְחַלְּצוֹ מדינה וכ' It means, He will 
<italic>deliver him</italic> from the judgment &c. Ib. (after ref. to יחליץ, Is. LVIII, 11) the root חלץ means both (girding and loosening), but here (Deut. l. c.), if it meant

<notes /></sense>

<notes /></sense>

<italic>to smoothen, give ease of mind</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Lev. R. s. 34 (ref. to יחליץ, Is. l. c.) יזיין (Ar. ישלוף) ישמוט ישזיב ויניח (which means) He shall 
<italic>loosen</italic> as in Deut. l. c., 
<italic>gird</italic> as ib. III, 18, 
<italic>deliver</italic> as in Ps. CXL, 2, 
<pgbrk id="pg473" />and 
<italic>give ease</italic> as in the Sabbath prayer after meal רצה והַחֲלִיצֵנוּ be pleased to give us ease of mind. V. חִלּוּץ.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="H01112">
<head-word>חָלַק</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (b. h.) </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be smooth, to be viscous</italic>.</definition>
<notes> V. חָלָק.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition> (denom. of חֵלֶק) 
<italic>to assign, allot</italic>.</definition>
<notes>—ח' כבוד 
<italic>to honor, pay regards</italic>. Ber. 19
<sup>b</sup>, a. e. כל מקום … אין חֹולְקִין וכ' wherever the desecration of the name of the Lord is threatened, no regards must be paid to a teacher. Zeb. 102
<sup>a</sup>; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition> (denom. of חֵלֶק) 
<italic>to divide </italic>(
<italic>by lot</italic>)
<italic>; to part; to take a share.</italic></definition>
<notes> Peah III, 5 האחין שחָלְקוּ brothers who divided an estate. B. Mets. I, 1, a. fr. יַחֲלֹוקוּ they shall divide the object (equally). Zeb. XII, 1 אינן חֹולְקִין וכ' take no share &c. Ḥull. 65
<sup>a</sup> אם חֹולֵק את רגליו וכ' if the birds parts its toes (on the rope) so that there be two on each side &c. Y. Sabb. VII, 9
<sup>c</sup> bot. דבר … אינו חולק if a prohibition (included in a law) is specified again for a purpose, it does not intimate a division (that each single act of the class must be atoned for singly, v. הַבְעָרָה). Tosef. Dem. VI, 1 חֹולְקָן he divides the fruits with the landlord. [Ib. 2 החולק, read: החֹוכֵר.] Y. ib. VI, beg. 25
<sup>a</sup> מישראל חולק if the property is farmed from an Israelite, he divides the produces (before separating T’rumah); a. v. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—4)</number>
<definition> (with על) 
<italic>to differ with, object, oppose</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Sabb. XV, beg. 15
<sup>a</sup> מה חוֹלְקִין על וכ' how is it? do they differ with &c.?—Ber. 27
<sup>b</sup> החולק על ישיבתו וכ' וכ'; Snh. 110
<sup>a</sup> הח' על רבו (Ar. הנֶחְלַק, 
<italic>Nif.</italic>) he who opposes (the school of) his teacher. Ber. l. c. כלום יש אדם חֹולֵק בדבר זה is there any one here differing from this opinion?; a. v. fr.—
<italic>Part. pass</italic>. חָלוּק, pl. חֲלוּקִים, חֲלוּקִין 
<italic>divided, interrupted; disputed; of different opinion.</italic> Mikv. VIII, 2 מים ח' interrupted flow of urin.—B. Bath. 176
<sup>a</sup> ח' היה ר' וכ' R. … differed &c. Ib. IX, 10 (158
<sup>b</sup>) על החֲלוּקִין ואתה בא לחַלֵּק עלינו וכ' … we grieve over the divided opinions, and you come to assert a division for us on things on which they (the schools of Shammai and Hillel) agree?; (Y. Shek. III, beg. 47
<sup>b</sup> לַחֲלֹוק). Y. Keth. I, end, 26
<sup>a</sup> ח' על אביו differs with his father; a. fr.—Tosef. Yoma V (IV), 6, a. e. ארבעה חֲלוּקֵי כפרה there are four persons under different categories as to atonement. Arakh. 10
<sup>b</sup> דחֲלוּקָה בקרבנותיה which differs (from other days) as regards sacrifices. Ib. חֲלוּקִין וכ' the numbers of sacrifices are different each day.</notes></sense></senses>

<number>—2)</number>

<notes> Ber. 27
<sup>b</sup>; Snh. 110
<sup>a</sup>, v. supra. Keth. XIII, 1; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הֶחֱלִיק</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to smoothen, make even, level; to improve the appearance.</italic></definition>
<notes> Maasr. I, 8 משיַחֲלִיקֶנּוּ from the moment that he smoothens the cake of figs (by rubbing it with figs or grapes). Ib. המַחֲלִיק בענבים if one uses grapes for smoothening.—Shebi. IV, 4 במַחֲלִיק when one levels a field (by taking out plants); expl. ib. המח' ג' זה בצד זה 
<italic>levelling</italic> means taking out (at least) three plants next to each other, contrad. to המדל, taking out one or two plants.—Peah III, 3, v. אֶחָד; a. e.—Trnsf. 
<italic>to close a tune softly</italic> (piano). Arakh. II, 3 (10
<sup>a</sup>) ולא היה מַחֲלִיק אלא … מפני שהוא מחליק יפה (Talm. ed. ולא היה מְחַלֵּק מחליק וכ' …) none but a flute solo was used for closing a tune, because it makes a pleasant finale.—3) 
<italic>to glide, slip</italic>. Erub. X, 14 בשביל שלא יַחֲלִיקוּ that the priests might not slip. B. Mets. VI, 3 אם הֶחֱלִיקָה if the animal injured herself by slipping.—4) 
<italic>to be smooth</italic>. Yeb. 80
<sup>b</sup> בשרו מַחֲלִיק his flesh is smooth.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hof.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הוּחֲלַק</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be injured by slipping</italic>.</definition>
<notes> B. Kam. 47
<sup>b</sup> הוּחְלְקָה בהן the animal was injured by tripping over the fruits.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
